in_marathi.name: Durvesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durvesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Durvesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'durvesh', which means 'difficult', 'inimical', or 'harmful'. In Hindu mythology, Durvesh is the name of an Asura (demon) who is a sworn enemy of the gods. He is often depicted as the embodiment of obstacles and challenges. Despite his negative connotations, the name Durvesh is also believed to bestow the strength and determination to overcome adversity.
